totals.households_note: Unavailable: intervention-area livelihood beneficiaries require a field-tested employment/adoption model; exposed cell population is not a household count.

npv.note: FloodAdapt-style discounted benefits minus capex + 2%/yr O&M. Not a GCF appraisal and not a field cash-flow.

appraisal.note: Screening-grade CLIMADA-style appraisal: monetised people-risk + CO₂ + income over cost using provenance.monetisation. Not a field BCR and not a CLIMADA run. Screening climate multiplier is min(100/7.75, 5) = 5.00. It scales annual people-risk under constant measure efficacy — not a hydrodynamic future flood.

pathways.trigger: if late-sample recurrence of the early 100-yr depth stays ≤ 10 yr

phases.blurb: Add the next tranche if late-sample recurrence stays ≤ 10 yr.

pathways.note: Independent-benefit add like CLIMADA combine_measures on the greedy frontier. Per-cell overlap capping still applies within a phase. Not an adaptation-pathway solver.

exceedance.method: Empirical (1-1/RP) quantile of Monte-Carlo annual people-risk. Not a CLIMADA Impact.calc_freq_curve run.

waterfall.note: CLIMADA-style waterfall with zero socioeconomic development. Measures keep today's fractional efficacy under the screening climate multiplier.

regret.note: Rhodium-style regret: each objective book scored in current vs GEV intensified_tail. Not a SWMM rainfall file. Intensified people-risk is the screening climate multiplier.

equity.method: rural-dense proxy already on hazard cells; not CDC SVI
equity.note: Who captured the avoided people-risk, using the existing 1.0–1.5× equity weight.

event_view.note: People in cells with HAND-proxy depth ≥ 0.05 m at that RP. Not a 0.5 m building-damage threshold and not a CLIMADA event view.

infographic.p30_formula: 1-(1-1/RP)^30 on rp10 cells with HAND-proxy depth ≥ threshold
infographic.note: FloodAdapt LikelyFlooded analog. Counts modeled people in rp10 cells, not unique homes. Threshold is 5 cm because this HAND proxy is centimetre-scale.

measure_catalog.source: Vetiver hedgerows cut slope erosion >90% (Truong et al.); cost/income from ICIMOD bioengineering field costings.
Bamboo root reinforcement for shallow landslides; bamboo is an established Nepali rural cash crop (INBAR).
NbS flood-depth reduction ~15-40% (UNEP); floodplain reconnection costs from World Bank NbS catalogue.
Wetland attenuation of peak flows; high soil-carbon uptake (Ramsar / IPCC wetlands supplement).
Catchment afforestation for slope stability and infiltration; sequestration from IPCC AFOLU defaults.
Bioengineered riverbank protection (live crib walls, brush layering) per ICIMOD/DSCWM manuals.

measure_catalog.note: RootLedger is NbS-only. FloodAdapt household elevate/buyout/floodproof measures are out of catalog.

optimality.note: Upper bound ignores per-cell overlap capping, so the true gap is smaller.

robustness.interpretation: Measures selected by both expected-value and CVaR objectives are robust to the choice of portfolio objective under the stated Monte-Carlo scenarios.

provenance.data_status: counterfactual simulation — deterministic candidate suitability plus literature-based intervention effects; field verification required
provenance.method: marginal greedy triple-return/$ with per-cell EAL capping over 500 Monte-Carlo hazard scenarios; climate multiplier sigma=0.252 from GEV 100-yr CI; objective=expected

factors.source: Vetiver hedgerows cut slope erosion >90% (Truong et al.); cost/income from ICIMOD bioengineering field costings.
Bamboo root reinforcement for shallow landslides; bamboo is an established Nepali rural cash crop (INBAR).
NbS flood-depth reduction ~15-40% (UNEP); floodplain reconnection costs from World Bank NbS catalogue.
Wetland attenuation of peak flows; high soil-carbon uptake (Ramsar / IPCC wetlands supplement).
Catchment afforestation for slope stability and infiltration; sequestration from IPCC AFOLU defaults.
Bioengineered riverbank protection (live crib walls, brush layering) per ICIMOD/DSCWM manuals.
